bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to environment; appropriating money for a water quality improvement project in Rice County and extending a previous appropriation for that purpose.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; FRENCH LAKE WATER-QUALITY IMPROVEMENT. +]

[+$....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Pollution Control Agency for a grant to Rice County to address water-quality concerns at French Lake. Rice County may use this grant to contract for water-quality improvement services, testing, necessary infrastructure, training, and maintenance. +]

Sec. 2. [+APPROPRIATION EXTENSION; FRENCH LAKE WATER-QUALITY IMPROVEMENT GRANT. +]

[+The availability of the grant to Rice County to address water-quality concerns at French Lake under Laws 2023, chapter 60, article 1, section 2, subdivision 2, paragraph (m), is extended to June 30, 2027. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to environment; appropriating money for a water quality improvement project in Rice County and extending a previous appropriation for that purpose.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; FRENCH LAKE WATER-QUALITY IMPROVEMENT.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Pollution Control Agency for a grant to Rice County to address water-quality concerns at French Lake. Rice County may use this grant to contract for water-quality improvement services, testing, necessary infrastructure, training, and maintenance.

Sec. 2. APPROPRIATION EXTENSION; FRENCH LAKE WATER-QUALITY IMPROVEMENT GRANT.

The availability of the grant to Rice County to address water-quality concerns at French Lake under Laws 2023, chapter 60, article 1, section 2, subdivision 2, paragraph (m), is extended to June 30, 2027.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: $....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Pollution Control Agency for a grant to Rice County to address water-quality concerns at French Lake. Rice County may use this grant to contract for water-quality improvement services, testing, necessary infrastructure, training, and maintenance.
APPROPRIATION EXTENSION; FRENCH LAKE WATER-QUALITY IMPROVEMENT GRANT.

The availability of the grant to Rice County to address water-quality concerns at French Lake under Laws 2023, chapter 60, article 1, section 2, subdivision 2, paragraph (m), is extended to June 30, 2027.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
